objects.description: This interior space is a contemporary bedroom with a minimalist modern design. The wardrobe features sliding glass doors with frosted glass panels and metallic frames, reflecting a blend of modern and Indian aesthetics. The space utilizes a neutral color palette of gray, white, and brown. Modern furniture, including a comfortable sofa, complements the overall design. The integration of wall-mounted lighting adds a touch of sophistication.

metadata.budget_indicator: Mid-range due to the use of modern materials like glass and metallic frames
metadata.indian_specific: Mild Indian influence in the modern wardrobe design

description: The interior space features a contemporary minimalist bedroom with sleek sliding wardrobe doors that incorporate traditional Indian design elements in the form of arched tops. The room is characterized by its clean lines, modern furniture, and a neutral color palette. The emphasis is on functionality and space optimization, with storage features seamlessly integrated into the wardrobe design. The overall aesthetic is a modern interpretation of traditional Indian design, evident in the use of natural wood tones and the incorporation of arched forms.

metadata.budget_indicator: Moderate to High, due to the use of polished materials like wood and metal, and the modern design aesthetic.
metadata.functionality: Primary purpose is for sleeping and storage, with the wardrobe doors storing clothes and other personal items.
metadata.indian_specific: Arched top design of the wardrobe doors
